attempts.summary: Deployed a small inventory web application on node1, served over TCP 8181 via a systemd-managed service confined by a dedicated, enforcing AppArmor profile ('inventory-app'), while AppArmor remained in enforce mode throughout (no profile was set to complain, and AppArmor was never disabled). Verified the service, port, data, and confinement all survive a full native reboot of node1.
